chunks: And in the narration of ʿUbaydullāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Barīrah was with a husband of hers while she was enslaved, then ʿĀʾishah bought her and set her free. So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله gave her the choice: if she wished, she could remain with her husband, and if she wished, she could separate from him. Her masters who sold her had stipulated her walāʾ for ʿĀʾishah, so the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “The walāʾ belongs to the one who emancipates.” Meat was given to Barīrah as charity, and she gifted it to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, so ʿĀʾishah hung it up and said that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله does not eat charity. Then the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله came while the meat was hanging and said: “What is the matter with this meat that it has not been cooked?” She said: “O Messenger of Allah, it was given as charity to Barīrah, and you do not eat charity.” So he صلى الله عليه وآله said: “It is charity for her and a gift for us.” Then he ordered that it be cooked, and three sunnahs occurred in it.

key_terms.أَعْتَقَتْهَا: she set her free; the act of emancipation
key_terms.بَرِيرَةَ: Barīrah, the freed bondwoman whose case became the basis for several rulings
key_terms.مَمْلُوكَةٌ: enslaved; indicating her legal status before emancipation
key_terms.هَدِيَّةٌ: a gift, which differs legally from charity in this context
key_terms.ٱلسُّنَنِ: established normative rulings or precedents drawn from the incident
key_terms.ٱلصَّدَقَةَ: charity given to a recipient as alms
key_terms.ٱلْوَلَاءُ: the right of clientship/allegiance connected to emancipation

ai.seo_question: What legal rulings were established in the hadith of Barīrah?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts the case of Barīrah and derives three legal sunnahs from it. It addresses the right of an emancipated bondwoman regarding her marriage, the rule that walāʾ belongs to the emancipator, and the distinction between charity for one recipient and a lawful gift for another.
